concepts.gloss_en: bringing/actualizing from potential into actual — the process identified with speech (dibbur)

members.note: representative; participle form, equated with dibbur/speech in lm1:25
infinitive of the same fixed idiom; in lm1:66 same actualization-via-speech concept ('על ידי שלמות הדיבור'). Grammatical inflection only, no semantic shift

notes: Difference is purely grammatical (participle מוציא vs infinitive להוציא) of one Aristotelian idiom 'from potential to actual'; both usages tie it to speech. Same concept.
